# FinTech Platform Overview

## Overview
This dashboard provides Vantage Financial Technologies with a comprehensive view of transaction volume, payment success rates, compliance standing, and API performance. It is designed for risk officers, compliance teams, and engineering leads who require real-time financial infrastructure monitoring.

## Key Metrics
- Daily Transactions: 47,200
- Transaction Success Rate: 99.2%
- Open Compliance Flags: 11
- API Latency (avg): 142ms
- Monthly Active Accounts: 28,400

## Insights
- Transaction success rate of 99.2% is within the 99.0% SLA floor; latency spike on Apr 12 was linked to a payment rail incident now resolved
- 11 open compliance flags require triage; 3 are high-priority KYC exceptions pending manual review
- Monthly active accounts grew 6.4% month-over-month, driven by wallet module expansion in APAC markets

widgets.title: Transaction Type Breakdown

widgets.title: API Latency Trend
widgets.description: Tracks average API response latency in milliseconds on a monthly basis to monitor payment rail performance and identify degradation events.

widgets.title: Compliance Flags by Category
